title: Revithia Farfalle Noodle Salad
description: A refreshing Japanese-inspired salad combining springy farfalle noodles with revithia chickpeas, lightly tossed in a zesty dressing.
instructions: 1. Cook the farfalle noodles according to package instructions, then set aside to cool.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, rice vinegar, honey, grated ginger, and green chili flakes.
3. Add the toasted sesame seeds to the bowl and stir to combine.
4. Add the cooled farfalle noodles to the bowl and toss to coat with the dressing.
5. Stir in the revithia chickpeas and spring onion.
6. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
7. Serve chilled or at room temperature.
8. Garnish with additional sesame seeds and spring onion if desired.
